_meta.description: Verified component dependencies extracted from Figma Desktop MCP get_design_context calls. Keys are Figma frame names matching DEPENDENCY_MAP. Values list Figma frame names of nested component instances found in generated code.
_meta.method: get_design_context MCP tool — inspected generated TypeScript/React code for component function calls and data-name attributes

Reviews.notes: Star function explicitly called 5× inside Reviews component

Button group.notes: Button and TextButtonIconRight functions both called explicitly

Toast Bar.notes: Button function called explicitly; Close Button nested as data-name div (inlined). Previous map was missing Button.

Product Grid Card.notes: PriceAndLabel, Star, BadgesAndTags, IconsAction all used as functions. Button inlined. Previous map listed Reviews but Star is used directly, not through Reviews component.

Product Content.notes: StepperControl, BadgesAndTags, Star, PriceAndLabel, TextButtonIconRight all used as explicit functions. Button inlined. Previous map listed Stepper CTA and Reviews — both incorrect.

Modal Dialog.notes: Button, ModalButtonGroup, CloseButton, TextSection all explicit functions in generated code. Previous map was missing TextSection.

Free Trial Card.notes: Button and BadgesAndTags inlined (no explicit function calls found in generated code, but structural analysis confirms use). Previous map listed Stepper CTA — not found.

Carousel Product.notes: PriceAndLabel, Star, BadgesAndTags used as explicit functions. Button inlined. Previous map listed Next-Previous Buttons and Slider components — none found in design context output.

Basic Form.notes: All fields are inlined (no separate function calls), but structural data-name attributes confirm these component types are used. Map unchanged.

CTA Row.notes: No component function calls found. Uses inlined SVG icons and text only. Previous map listed Button — not present as a function call.

Increase-Decrease Buttons.notes: Leaf component — renders SVG icons directly, no other component function calls.

Next-Previous Buttons.notes: Uses IconsAction helper function (inline SVG icon), not a code component. No separate component dependencies.

Product Images.notes: Leaf component — just an with aspect-ratio variants.

Text Section.notes: Leaf component — text, icons, and list items all inlined.

Email Capture.notes: Button function explicitly called for the submit action.

Stateful Action Button.notes: Not directly captured; retained from original map as plausible.

Stepper Control.notes: Increase-Decrease Buttons appear as data-name children. Not separately verified via get_design_context for this component.

Stepper CTA.notes: Not directly captured; retained from original map as plausible.
